topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: The lines on my skin, they're not mine. I didn't ask for them, didn't want them. They bind me, these foreign marks, like a cage woven into my flesh. My skin, it whispers a story I never chose to tell. It's not just the pain of the ink; it's the violation, the loss of what was pure. Now, every glance mirrors the act, a constant reminder of hands that trespassed. The world feels smaller, my space invaded. I can't shake the shadows that linger, the silent accusations in each distorted stroke. What was once my canvas now echoes someone else's thought, and I am trapped within it.
